steps.message:
The change is a one-line edit, but it's a public contract change, so I'm stopping before touching it.

`routes/users.js:6` returns `userId` in `GET /users`. Per `README.md`, that response is consumed by the web app, the iOS app (3.2+), and the nightly partner export — and it states field names are part of the contract, with changes going through a versioned endpoint. Renaming in place breaks all three consumers immediately, including shipped iOS builds you can't update.

options.description: Change userId to user_id in routes/users.js:6 exactly as asked. Breaking: web app, iOS 3.2+, and the nightly partner export all stop seeing userId until they are updated. Choose this if the consumers are already coordinated.

options.label: Emit both fields
options.description: Return user_id alongside userId so new clients get the consistent name and existing consumers keep working. Non-breaking, but leaves a duplicated field to deprecate later.

options.label: Versioned endpoint
options.description: Follow the README's stated policy: keep /users as-is and expose the snake_case shape on a new version (e.g. /v2/users). Largest change of the three.
